Beijing 2008.name: Beijing 2008
Beijing 2008.summary: Embrace the competitive spirit of the world's most prestigious sporting event and represent your country as you compete for the highest honor - the Gold.

Ginsei Igo 2 - Next Generation.name: Ginsei Igo 2: Next Generation
Ginsei Igo 2 - Next Generation.summary: Ginsei Igo 2: Next Generation is a modern Go (Igo) adaptation focused on competitive play and training. It offers improved AI, tutorials and analysis tools, online and local multiplayer, adjustable handicaps and time controls, and a clean interface that preserves classic strategy while easing practice and competition.

Idolmaster Cinderella Girls, The - Gravu.name: The Idolmaster: Cinderella Girls - Gravure for You! Vol.8
Idolmaster Cinderella Girls, The - Gravu.summary:
This volume continues the ability to take pictures of two idols at a time, and to add music from CDs into the BGM list. When the selected idol wears the Dreamy Wedding or Dark Rose Fantasy outfits, the player can take pictures of the idols sitting with the dress' skirt billowing around them.
Idol Focus: Chieri Ogata
Costumes: Dark Rose Fantasy, Bikini of Siren, Dreamy Wedding
Locations: Halloween Manor, Nighttime Beach, Church

Metro - Last Light - Complete Edition.name: Metro: Last Light - Complete Edition
Metro - Last Light - Complete Edition.summary:
It is the year 2034. Beneath the ruins of post-apocalyptic Moscow, in the tunnels of the Metro, the remnants of mankind are besieged by deadly threats from outside – and within.

Mutants stalk the catacombs beneath the desolate surface, and hunt amidst the poisoned skies above. But rather than stand united, the station-cities of the Metro are locked in a struggle for the ultimate power, a doomsday device from the military vaults of D6. A civil war is stirring that could wipe humanity from the face of the earth forever. As Artyom, burdened by guilt but driven by hope, you hold the key to our survival – the last light in our darkest hour...

NASCAR '14.name: NASCAR '14
NASCAR '14.summary: It's your turn to immerse yourself in the full-throttle thrill of the world's most exciting motor sports racing series in NASCAR '14. Take the wheel from your favorite driver and participate in the race week experience complete with practice, qualifying, and race day challenges. With your favorite personalities and live replay, NASCAR '14 is the authentic NASCAR experience for fans.

Sophie no Atelier - Fushigi na Hon no Re.name: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book
Sophie no Atelier - Fushigi na Hon no Re.summary:
Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book is an upcoming Japanese role-playing video game. It is the 17th main game in the "Atelier" series.

The game features a completely reformed world view from earlier titles within the series, in addition to a new alchemy-centric system. Sophie is able to obtain ideas for recipes from activities such as harvesting, exploring, battling, or from events, and these ideas are used as a basis of improving her knowledge of alchemy.

When she performs alchemy, the player is presented with various predetermined shapes representing the ingredients used, and arranges each shape on a puzzle board that represents the cauldron. This process involves visual trial-and-error, and if the shapes are arranged perfectly, the player receives a bonus. The materials selected affect the quality of the item synthesized. This system is intended to offer a high degree of freedom based on the player's own play style.

Super Street Fighter IV.name: Super Street Fighter IV
Super Street Fighter IV.summary: Super Street Fighter IV is a 2010 fighting game produced by Capcom. It is an updated version of Street Fighter IV and has been said to mark the definitive end of the Street Fighter IV series. Having been deemed as too large an update to be deployed as DLC, the game was made into a standalone title, but given a lower price than that of a full retail game.

Transformers - Dark of the Moon.name: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
Transformers - Dark of the Moon.summary: The Transformers: Dark of the Moon video game allows players to fight through the epic battles on Earth that will shape the events of the movie. Armed with a brand-new gameplay mechanic, fans will harness the power of Stealth Force to instantly convert to a third, hybrid state that combines the weapons and firepower of robot mode with the agility and maneuverability of vehicle mode. Set in unique environments around the world such as the Jungles of South America, Siberian military facilities, Detroit Cityscapes and more, the game lets players assume the roles of a diverse roster of everyone's favorite Transformers from the movie through a heart-pounding campaign to save mankind. Additionally, fans can play the game with or against their friends through intense, online multiplayer game modes as their favorite iconic characters.
